meta.title: Assignee dropdown is scrollable and searchable in both individual and bulk flows

plan.title: Search Assignee in Individual and Bulk Flows

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions page where the PR line-item and bulk assignee controls are available.
Use the Open tab because assignee actions are performed on an open purchase request.

args.goal: On the Open purchase requisitions page, open Add Assignee from the plus icon for one individual line item, verify the assignee dropdown opens and is scrollable, type a user's name into its search field and verify the matching user appears; then select several items, open the bulk Add Assignee control, verify the dropdown is scrollable, type the same user's name into its search field and verify the matching user appears; stop on the bulk dropdown showing the matching user.

steps.note: Execute and observe both the individual-line and bulk Add Assignee dropdown search flows, including scrolling and narrowing to the matching user.
Confirm the final assignee search screen has no crash, server error, or malformed content.
